The `blowhorn github` commands. Each one's `--help` prints the same text.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`github squatters`](#blowhorn-github-squatters) | Sweep a repository's assigned-but-stalled issues through GitHub's GraphQL API. |

## blowhorn github squatters

Sweep a repository's assigned-but-stalled issues through GitHub's GraphQL API.

For each assignee whose silence -- measured from the later of their assignment date and their last activity (a comment, a linked PR, a status change) -- reaches `--nudge-after-days` (default 14), the action posts a fixed-template nudge; `--warn-after-days` (default 7) later with still no reply it posts a final warning; `--unassign-after-days` (default 7) after that it removes the assignee and posts a closing comment. Issues with an open linked PR from the assignee, blocked or waiting-on-maintainer labels, security labels, or an assignee who is the issue's own author are never bumped. A dry run is the default: without `--apply` the sweep prints exactly what it would do and writes nothing. Immediately before any write the issue is re-read, so a run never unassigns someone who just became active. No CLI is required: the sweep talks to GitHub's GraphQL API over HTTPS with the store's GitHub token, and a token that is missing or unauthenticated is a hard error, never a silent fallback.

```text
blowhorn github squatters [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--repo` | string |  | Repository to sweep, as owner/name |
| `--apply` | boolean | `false` | Perform the writes: post the nudge, warning, or closing comment and remove the assignment. Without `--apply` the run is a dry-run preview and writes nothing |
| `--limit` | integer | `100` | Maximum open issues examined in the run (default 100) |
| `--nudge-after-days` | integer | `14` | Days of assignee silence before a nudge is posted (default 14) |
| `--warn-after-days` | integer | `7` | Days after a nudge with still no reply before the final warning (default 7) |
| `--unassign-after-days` | integer | `7` | Days after the final warning with still no reply before the assignment is released (default 7) |
| `--platform` | string |  | Platform scope for `blowhorn github`. One of: github, all (`all` means every platform listed here) |
| `--pace` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn github squatters` because `--pace` is a global flag, but this command does no paced work -- it sleeps between nothing -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs and appears only in the Pace column of the -v summary. Resolved as CLI flag, then `BLOWHORN_PACE`, then defaults.pace in .blowhorn.yaml (normal when none is set); an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |
| `--risk-profile` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn github squatters` because `--risk-profile` is a global flag, but this command does no gated work -- no Risk Profile hold, cap or pace applies to it -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs. A value after the command word wins over one before it; an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |

Also takes the [shared flags](/docs/reference/cli/shared-flags/): `--config`, `--log-dir`, `--profile`, `--exclude`, `--headless`, `--chrome-launch`, `--headed`, `--dry-run`, `--verbose`.

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn github squatters --repo owner/name --dry-run
blowhorn github squatters --repo owner/name --apply
blowhorn github squatters --repo owner/name --dry-run --nudge-after-days 21
```

Output: text.
